judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning and red-phase acceptance test generation step without actually implementing any of the production changes. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, `package.json`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, and `.specify/spec.md` are completely untouched. Because the candidate added acceptance tests asserting the new validation behavior against the unpatched `ToolRegistry`, the test suite will fail immediately. While the spec file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`) and test cases align well with the problem statement, the core feature and documentation updates are entirely missing, and an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file was left in the tree.
